title: Founder story UI and evidence inspection

files.change: Focused story component with typed view model.
Situation, action timeline, outcomes, matches/differences and experiment.
Responsive readable chapters and expandable tracks; no scroll-overlap animation.
Integrate component and progressive context; preserve auth/navigation.
Replace generic focus narrative section with story component, not login redesign.
Typed v1 endpoints, partial/case/pattern states and provenance.

steps: Source drawer shows original document, page/passage, date semantics and review state.
Tracks include pricing/team/marketing/IP/legal even when research is incomplete; no fake complete timeline.
Label contemporary context vs historical choices. A founder gets a concrete experiment with assumptions and success measure.
Separate requested future CSS login restoration from this goal; do not redesign login during story implementation.
tests: Real rendered tests at 360/390px mobile and 1366px desktop, keyboard and reduced motion.
Authenticated screenshot review of 0/1/multiple cases, long text, missing dates and disputed evidence.
Verify public deployment, not localhost-only behavior; do not bypass auth for screenshot.
completion_evidence: mobile/desktop screenshots with test account approved by user
18 baseline frontend tests plus new interaction/rendering tests
